headword: {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}

definitions.explanation: An announcement or message related to work operations, typically circulated within an organization to share practical information.

examples.japanese: {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send a business notice by email.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: A work-related notice was communicated at the morning meeting.

examples.japanese: {全社員|ぜんしゃいん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧{旨|むね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a company-wide business notice, employees were informed that the system would change starting next month.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧ (business operations) and ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (contact, communication). Used in offices, shops, and organizations for practical announcements — schedule changes, system updates, reminders, etc.

In retail and service settings, {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく} is often heard over a PA system as a staff-only announcement, signaling that the message is for employees rather than customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}です: "This is a staff announcement" (PA system)
- {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: business communication email
- {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to circulate a work notice
- {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: items for business communication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社内連絡|しゃないれんらく}: internal company communication — similar but specifically within a company, while {業務連絡|ぎょうむれんらく} can be used in non-corporate settings too
- ⟦{通達|つうたつ}→通達：22238_tsuutatsu⟧: official directive — more formal and authoritative, often from management to subordinates
- ⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧: notice, announcement — more general and can be directed at customers or the public
